texts.text:
The federal short-term rate determined in accordance with section 1274(d)
during October 2025 is the rate published in Revenue Ruling 2025-21, 2025-45 IRB
690, to take effect beginning November 1, 2025. The federal short-term rate, rounded
to the nearest full percent, based on daily compounding determined during the month
of October 2025 is 4 percent. Accordingly, an overpayment rate of 7 percent (6
percent in the case of a corporation) and an underpayment rate of 7 percent are
established for the calendar quarter beginning January 1, 2026. The overpayment
rate for the portion of a corporate overpayment exceeding $10,000 for the calendar
quarter beginning January 1, 2026, is 4.5 percent. The underpayment rate for large
corporate underpayments for the calendar quarter beginning January 1, 2026, is 9
percent.
